text:
Version 2.4 is out. Here's what changed.

We fixed **12 crashes**, so the app should run more smoothly and stop interrupting you unexpectedly.

Startup is faster too. It dropped from 3.4 seconds to **1.9 seconds**.

The biggest addition is **Offline Mode**. You can keep exploring, creating, and getting things done even when your connection drops, so you no longer need Wi-Fi to keep working.

One thing to note: Version 2.4 no longer supports **Android 8**. Dropping it lets us put more of our effort into new features and performance improvements for newer devices. If you're on Android 8, you'll need to upgrade your device to keep getting updates.

Thanks for being part of our community. Update today to get these changes.
